title: WeftMate — It remembers you. It gets things done.
description: A personal AI assistant that lives on your computer. Give it a goal, follow the work, and pick up on your phone. Try the interactive WeftMate demo.
heroBody: Meet the AI assistant that lives on your computer. Give it a goal. Watch it do the work. Pick up on your phone or watch, with the same assistant that remembers what matters to you.
heroNote: Your computer holds your data · Your choice of model
demoTitle:
Don’t take our word for it.
Try it yourself.
demoBody: Approve a step. Open the report. Correct a memory. See where it goes next.
demoNote: An interactive story with fictional content. No files are changed and no AI model is called.
waiting: Your turn. Choose Allow to let it continue.
done: All done. Try another scene, or play this one again.
stopped: Declined. No files were moved. Start over to try again.
memoryHint: Open the memories to see their sources. Try correcting or forgetting one.
staticNote: Enable JavaScript to try approvals and memory corrections.
workTitle:
Tell it the outcome.
It brings back the work.
workBody: You shouldn't have to turn every goal into a list of instructions. It reads files, runs commands, organizes material, and writes the report. Follow the work in your conversation. Stop anytime, or queue up what comes next.
workSmall: When a step needs your decision, it asks right there. Allow it once, or allow similar actions in future. Finished files arrive as one tidy list.
workPrompt: Organize this month's files and write a report I can actually use.
workProgress: Read 213 files · Found 38 files to organize
workFinish: 213 files reviewed, 38 put in place. The 6 duplicates are untouched. Your report and inventory are ready.
memoryTitle:
You said it last week.
You don't have to say it again.
memoryBody: It learns from everyday conversations. No extra notes to keep. In a new conversation, it can find what matters by meaning.
memorySmall: See what it remembers. Correct what it got wrong. Fully forget what you don't want kept. A weekly memory note shows what's new. For a conversation you don't want remembered, go temporary.
memoryOld: I like cycling on weekends. Keep the route under 20 km.
memoryOldReply: Got it. I’ll look for routes under 20 km.
memoryRequest: Any ideas for a relaxing weekend?
memoryReply: How about a quiet riverside ride? Keep it under 20 km, with a stop at a little café along the way.
memoryOne: Enjoys weekend cycling and quiet routes.
corrected: Memory updated. The demo now uses your new preference.
forgotten: Distance preference forgotten. The demo no longer uses it.
memoryNewReply: How about a quiet riverside ride? Keep it under 30 km, with a stop at a little café along the way.
memoryForgotReply: How about a quiet riverside ride, with a stop at a little café along the way?
weeklyDetail: New preferences and corrections, together in one place.
devicesTitle:
Step away from your desk.
Stay with the task.
devicesBody: Windows. Mac. Android. iPhone. Apple Watch. Follow your computer's progress on your phone, approve from a notification, or handle a request on your wrist. Change devices, conversations, or models. It's still the same assistant.
deviceCaption: Interface illustration · One task, the same moment
watchDesc: A quick decision on your wrist
phoneRequest: Your quarterly review is ready. Replace the older PDF in the shared folder?
phoneLead: Out the door. Still your decision.
phoneAllowed: Approved here. Your computer is saving it.
phoneFinished: The updated PDF is in the shared folder.
watchHint: Handle approvals on your watch, too
dataTitle:
Your life.
On your own computer.
dataBody: Conversations, attachments, and memories are stored primarily on your computer. WeftMate's cloud handles essentials like accounts, connections, and notifications. It doesn't store conversation text or memory content.
dataModel: Bring your own API, or run a model locally. When you choose a third-party model, your device sends your messages and the relevant memories selected for that reply directly to the provider, under its privacy policy.
dataLocal: Use it on your own computer without signing in. Sign in when you need remote access.
dataBusiness: We don't sell models or require a membership today. Any third-party model costs are yours.
dataFlow: Messages and memories needed for a reply
dataFoot: We don't sell your personal information or use your content to train models.
detailsTitle:
The big work, finished.
The little things, considered.
details: One main chat. Room for side chats.
Keep everyday life together. Give a specific task its own space.
Progress, plans, and finished files, each with a place to land.
Turn “Every Friday, help me…” into something that happens on time.
Find conversations, memories, files, and scheduled tasks.
Right-click a file or folder in Windows and hand it over.
Code, tables, formulas, and diagrams, clearly presented.
A little help with what's next
Pick a suggested next step and keep moving.
Check when you want to. Repair a troubled connection on your computer.
It keeps track of what you've been working on and picks it up in conversation, with a weekly look back at results and to-dos.
A second look at risky actions
Before you approve, another model checks the step and notes any concern right beside the request. The decision stays yours.
futureTitle:
More of your day.
More understood.
futureBody: Here's what's on the way. Each step brings your assistant a little closer to everyday life.
future: Health data from iPhone and Watch

Let past conversations help it get to know you, without starting over.

getNote: Bring your own model · No membership required
getFoot: Public downloads are coming soon. Availability details will be announced here.
